summary: First iteration full-stack test of the German Familien-App MVP. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass covering auth (username-login, wrong pw German error, Bearer /auth/me), role protection (Mama -> 403 on admin endpoints), users CRUD, cannot-delete-self, profile update + role immutability, password change, dishes CRUD, mealplan GET/PUT/DELETE + to-shopping transfer, shopping quick-add/toggle/delete/clear + top products, events CRUD with color assignment + birthday shared color, MV holidays (Frauentag + Reformationstag), webauthn register/begin + availability endpoint, VAPID key + push test with no subscription, admin export/reset preserving users. Frontend: 15/15 Playwright checks pass covering wrong-password German error, admin login -> dashboard, admin tile visibility, weekly toggle, mealplan tabs & persons toggles, dish create via manager, inline meal-entry save + delete, transfer to shopping, shopping quick-add via Enter, clear-done, calendar month nav + event create with 24h push reminder, profile save with color pick, WebAuthn register button present, test-push button clickable, admin creates new user and it appears in list.
critical_code_review_comments: Password change endpoint does not enforce minimum length / complexity — trivial passwords accepted
Admin reset-password endpoint accepts arbitrary new password without any policy

CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True and allow_origins from env (currently '*'). Browsers reject credential-carrying requests with wildcard origins; set an explicit allowed origin list in production.
Login endpoint has no brute-force lockout / rate limiting; playbook mentions 5-fail lockout — not implemented

Push _deliver deletes subscription with s['_id'] but subs are fetched WITHOUT projection excluding _id which is fine, but same collection is queried with {'_id':0} elsewhere — mildly inconsistent. Safe here because no projection.
webauthn/authenticate/complete falls back to first credential if id lookup fails — potential silent credential mismatch
seed() does not update existing admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD in env changes (playbook expected idempotent seed)
No forgot-password / email flow (out of MVP scope, noted)
Frontend stores JWT in localStorage — vulnerable to XSS; playbook expects httpOnly cookies. Not required by user spec but flagged.
MealPlan/Shopping/Calendar all issue full reload() after every mutation instead of local state updates — acceptable but chatty
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all TEST_* artifacts cleaned up after run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with 'python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0' (sequential is required because TestAdminData.test_reset_content_preserves_users clears mealplan/dishes/shopping/events collections and would race with other suites under the pytest.ini default of -n 2). Reuse for regressions. WebAuthn register/authenticate complete flows cannot be end-to-end tested in headless — only /begin and availability are covered. Push delivery not testable (no real VAPID client).
